display:none; max-width:800px; margin:35px auto; padding:32px; background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--card-radius); box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);
div.p: Sarkari exam form ke liye photo aur signature ko exact dimensions aur KB me resize karein.

input.style: width:100%; padding:14px; border:2px dashed var(--brand); border-radius:10px; background:var(--surface-hover); box-sizing:border-box; cursor:pointer;

width:100%; padding:10px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; box-sizing:border-box;

button.style: width:100%; background:var(--brand); color:#ffffff; padding:13px; font-size:15px; font-weight:800; border:none; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer; text-transform:uppercase; box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(37,99,235,0.25);

div.style: display:none; margin-top:25px; text-align:center; border-top:1px solid var(--border); padding-top:20px;

img.style: max-width:220px; border:1px solid var(--border); padding:4px; border-radius:8px; display:block; margin:0 auto 10px;

a.style: display:inline-block; background:var(--brand); color:#ffffff; padding:10px 24px; text-decoration:none; border-radius:8px; font-weight:700; font-size:14px;
